cues: Its efficiency includes the cut off ratio, rho, equal to V three over V two.
For the same r, a diesel cycle is slightly less efficient than an Otto cycle.
But because r can be made so much bigger, the real diesel engine wins comfortably.
That is why trucks and buses run on diesel.
